pretreatments.description: Milling of pine wood chips to reduce particle size and increase surface area.
Alkali pretreatment with 8% sodium hydroxide solution at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Incubation of the alkali-pretreated mixture at 100 °C for 10 minutes, 30 minutes, or 60 minutes with mixing every 10 minutes.
Centrifugation at 4500 rpm (5000 g) to separate the solid and liquid fractions.
Washing of the settled solid with distilled water and vacuum filtration until pH 7 was achieved.
Storage of the treated solids at 4 °C in plastic bags.
Anaerobic batch digestion of the treated and untreated pine woods at mesophilic conditions (37 °C) with inoculum.
